changes.result: One causal chain now organizes the paper: fixed-trajectory write intervention -> stronger wording reduction -> matched downstream propagation -> bounded interpretation/generalization.
Title/abstract scope is narrowed from generic self-improving agents to reward-conditioned agent memory; broader writer/domain/live claims remain disallowed.
Introduction and Related Work explicitly surrender judge unreliability, feedback-driven memory construction, memory-reward amplification, and general variance novelty.
Paired provider completion is part of the Experimental Setup estimand; downstream source support is explicitly conditional on four complete pairs.
No-memory and GLM results are presented as branch-location and cross-writer boundaries rather than extra contributions.
Released top-1 retrieval reduction is integrated as a matched scientific stop for multi-bit full-bank interaction, not as omitted experimentation.
Research OS stage labels and reviewer-response language are removed from main scientific headings/prose; detailed execution accounting is moved to the appendix.
Conclusion describes the terminal confirmation as a same-support uniform replication after an initial non-pass, with unchanged support and dual gate.
Plug-in corruption variance is demoted to bounded consequence analysis and removed from the top-level conclusion contribution summary.
PaperStory V3 and the reader-facing C1 summary reflect fresh no-memory evidence, the GLM cross-writer boundary, and the top-1 retrieval reduction.

title_after: Reward Errors Become Persistent State: A Controlled Intervention in Reward-Conditioned Agent Memory
